title: Senior Lead Engineer - Technical Acoustics
jobDescription:
Job Description:
  • Provide implementable solutions from proven concepts and analytical models within the boundaries of product development on source and transmission control for target acoustic design requirements of compressors.
  • Develop design tools & methodology using principles of acoustics and fluid dynamics through mathematical formulations and modelling of subsystems and solutioning in MATLAB towards the prediction of acoustic behaviour of systems.
  • Responsible for development and validation of design proposals and solutions influencing acoustic targets by working together with CFT team.
  • Support & provide design solutions for product development across proto refinement stages & design problem solving for issues concerning the perceived sound quality of compressors in the product life cycle.
  • Execution of state of the art technology projects in acoustics from adjacencies through development and implementation of new concept / process as per business & roadmap requirements


Desired Profile:

Mechanical Engineering - M.E/M.Tech in Design (Applied mechanics / Acoustics/ Noise & Vibration) domain with 2-6 years of relevant experience as below


Core Experience:
  • Should have the design experience to analyse and provide optimized and validated designs through acoustic analysis of ducted systems and structural acoustics with relevant excitations to ensure functional and reliability requirements of rotating and reciprocating machineries.
  • Should be well versant with design, optimization and verification of acoustic properties for absorption, transmission loss, insertion loss and source characteristics through analytical formulations in MATLAB for modelling of ducted systems towards developing indigenous designs towards the prediction of acoustic behaviour of systems.
  • Predictive vibroacoustic for critical sources & transmission path control design of noise by design and selection of acoustic absorption materials and attenuators and validation through Analytical, Finite/Boundary element and & Statistical Energy based analysis of subsystems and coupled systems for overall acoustic system design.
  • Vibroacoustic analysis and optimization of structure borne sources incorporating mechanical and fluid dynamic excitations for prediction of vibroacoustic radiation and subsequent validation Vibroacoustic source characterisation and acoustic transfer path analysis through experimental approaches and postprocessing for feature extractions with multichannel systems (LMS Test Lab or similar).


Preferable Knowledge/Experience:
  • Exposure to experimental NVH for feature extractions through applied signal processing is an added advantage.
  • Experience Exposure to commercial numerical acoustic tools like Actran, Vitual Lab Acoustics is preferred.

title: Engineer
jobDescription:
Job Description : 

  • The Product Development/subsystems engineer is responsible for designing new parts, subsystems and their integration into products. 
  • This includes concept development, design, improvement, problem solving, design verification and coordination with various stakeholders for subsequent implementation.
  • Should have the ability to carry out design calculations involving parts, subsystems & their integration into products 
  • Creating 3D models and detailing of concepts & development involving GD&T requirements
  • Make a design review following design guidelines, checklists, standards and prepare such a document wherever required
  • Follow design processes to meet DFMEA, DFM, DFA & DFS requirements & change management


Job Description: Product Development Engineer

Position: Product Development Engineer

Reporting to: Senior Product Development Engineer

No. of Direct Reports: Nil

No. of Indirect Reports: Nil

 

Key Purpose of the Job :

The Product Development Engineer is responsible for designing new parts, subsystems and products. This includes research and development, design, improvement, problem solving, testing activities. Coordinating for concept development, feasibility studies, design validation and proto manufacturing activities is critical to the role holder.

 

Educational Qualification / Experience required :

- Graduate in Engineering
- Experience of 2 to 4 years in design of industrial part / component / system
-Expertise in basic design calculations, Product development, 3D Modelling  and detailing with exposure to strength of materials, fluid mechanics, thermal engineering,  design of transmission elements (bearing, belt & gear), design of fluid joints (pipes, hoses, gasgets & couplings), design of structure & structural joints  (sheet metal & fabricated parts)

 

Key Responsibilities :

1. Prepare plan and schedule for product design and development activities including projects at various stages and across variants
2. Responsible for designing and developing components subsystems and compressor packages as per project plan and Elgi Product Development Process (EPDP)
3. Coordinate for design validation with the respective expert functions across Elgi
4. Provide technical inputs and support on design and development concepts for procurement and other development processes
5. Execute redesign and engineering activities, special projects as per business requirements

 

Task Analysis:

Indicative Tasks

1. Prepare plan and schedule for product design and development activities including projects at various stages and across variants

Collect inputs on project proposal and plan from Business Development (BD) (for example, inputs from Voice of Customers (VOC), new project proposals)

Study and analyze project proposal for design and development feasibility

Work along with project leads to develop detailed product development application objectives

Prepare concept document / drawing / 3 D model as appropriate based on project proposals

Collaborate with BD for validating project concept, make changes as appropriate to document / drawing based on inputs from BD

2. Responsible for designing and developing components subsystems and compressor packages as per project plan and Elgi Product Development Process (EPDP)

Collate and document project proposal, plan and concept drawings / documents for approvals at various stages and from stakeholders

Ensure adherence to Elgi product development principles, systems and guidelines including Elgi Product Development Process (EPDP)

Create and maintain part designs and drawings using design tools including SolidWorks, AutoCad, Pro E, and others

Apply knowledge of best design practices, industry standards and governing body regulations during design process

Employ Design for Manufacturing / Design for Assembly / Design for Service (DFM / DFA / DFS) concepts during design process

Ensure product development quality by adhering to First Time Right (FTR) principle and error free designs while developing designs

Review and analyze design to ensure feasibility of product concept, make changes as appropriate

Prepare reports on status of project tasks and milestones for each project handled

Conduct design review meetings with superior to ensure product development meets design control requirements

Prepare detailed product specifications / design requirements and process flow maps

Conduct manufacturing feasibility study as per formats, update drawings as appropriate

3. Coordinate for design validation with the respective expert functions across Elgi

Forward design and specifications to Subsystems & Experts team for simulation testing (for example, Computational Fluid Dynamics, Finite Element Analysis, etc)

Incorporate changes recommended by expert functions (for example, E&E, SS&E) into the design, as appropriate

Coordinate for testing and validation of products and its applications, make improvements / changes to design based on results

Finalize the design in collaboration with functional stakeholders

Handover final drawings, design and specifications to New Product Productionisation Organization (NPPO) team for proto manufacturing of product

Provide for adjustments / changes to drawings as appropriate based on feedback from NPPO assembling / manufacturing / machining processes

Assist in assembly of prototype products and validate the product concept

4. Provide technical inputs and support on design and development concepts for procurement and other development processes

Prepare engineering documentation, Bills of Material (BOMs), parts lists, engineering specifications, and other supporting documents and forms

Coordinate with respective function for requirements in the system for parts, materials required for production of new product

Provide inputs / clarifications on design to suppliers for raw materials, machine parts, components

Ensure requirements are correctly communicated to supplier, follow up for any further issues / manufacturing difficulties / deviation requests in parts / components

Calculate materials costs, modify design, requirements for cost optimization

Conduct meetings, prepare technical and status reports as required for internal distribution and external communication

Scale up production process via plant trials, make changes to raw materials or components and process parameters to ensure quality is maintained

Implement process controls and test methods to assess the production process

Deliver products that meets Elgi’s standards and also international standards and regulations, as appropriate

5. Execute redesign and engineering activities, special projects as per business requirements

Provide for changes / revisions in design and other Engineering Change Requests (ECR), as necessary (for example, correction of design error that isn't evident until testing and modeling, change in material or manufacturing method)

Conduct special processes as per project definition and scope and also business requirements (for example, developing new pattern for foundry projects and others)

Benchmark against competitor products and evaluate design competitiveness (for example, materials evaluation, component weight, cost benchmarking)

Conduct improvement studies on new machines (for example, noise reduction, package size reduction)

Conduct analysis and studies for cost reduction activities (for example, investigate alternative materials or new machinery to improve efficiency, quality)

Evaluate existing processes to identify areas for improvement

title: Senior Principal Engineer- (FSF) Fluid Separation and Filtration Systems in Compressors
location: Branch Office, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu , India
jobDescription:
Job Description

Position: Senior Principal Engineer- Fluid Separation and Filtration Systems in Compressors

Location: Coimbatore

Reports to:  Head of Mechanical Subsystems


Job Summary:

Principal Engineer for Fluid Separation and Filtration Systems in Compressors will be responsible for the design, development, and optimization of fluid separation and filtration systems used in compressor applications. This role involves design and selection of FSF components , ensuring product quality, working on improvement initiatives, and fostering innovation. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in pressure vessel design, thermodynamics, heat transfer, computational fluid dynamics (CFD), and analytical methods, along with effective interpersonal skills to work with CFT members.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and development of fluid separation and filtration systems
  • Working on analytical calculation, 3D modelling, detailing, execution, and completion of projects related to compressor fluid separation and filtration systems.
  • Collaborate with cross functional teams, including R&D, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to ensure product specifications and performance standards are met.
  • Content preparation for technical reviews and provide guidance on system design, materials selection, and testing protocols.
  •  Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Adhering to project timelines and working on budgets, ensuring timely delivery of milestones and deliverables.
  •  Execute improvement initiatives to enhance system performance, reliability, and cost effectiveness.
  •  Support innovation efforts, introducing new technologies and methodologies to improve fluid separation and filtration systems.
  • Provide technical support and training to other departments as needed.
  •  Prepare and present technical reports, proposals, and presentations to management and stakeholders.
  •  Apply principles of thermodynamics and heat transfer to optimize system performance.
  •  Design and analyse pressure vessels in accordance with applicable codes and standards.
  •  Utilize CFD and analytical methods to design, analyse, and optimize fluid separation and filtration systems.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  •  Project Completion Rate: Percentage of projects completed on time and within budget.
  •  System Performance Metrics: Achievements in key performance areas such as filtration efficiency, pressure drop, and system reliability.
  •  Innovation and Improvement: Number of process improvements, new patents, or innovative solutions implemented.
  •  Delivery: Delivery of project deliverables /milestones on weekly and monthly basis
  •  Customer Satisfaction: Feedback from internal and external customers regarding product performance and support.
  •  Compliance and Quality: Adherence to industry standards, regulations, and quality benchmarks.
  •  Cost Savings: Reduction in production costs through improved designs and processes.
  • Change Management Success: Effectiveness in managing and implementing changes with minimal disruption and resistance.


Qualifications

  •  Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering. A Master’s degree is preferred.
  •  In depth knowledge of fluid dynamics, filtration, fluid separation technologies and compressor systems.
  •  Proficiency in CAD software and other engineering design tools.
  •  Strong understanding of industry standards and regulatory requirements related to fluid separation and filtration.
  •  Knowledge of pressure vessel design principles and relevant codes and standards.
  •  Understanding of thermodynamics and heat transfer principles.
  •  Proficiency in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and analytical methods.


Experience

  •  Minimum of 10 years of experience in the field of fluid separation and filtration systems, preferably in compressor applications.
  •  Proven experience in new product design, development, research on the mechanical systems and software tools
  •  Demonstrated project management skills with a track record of successful project delivery.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  •  Proven track record of driving innovation and continuous improvement.
  •  Experience in managing change effectively within an engineering environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with cross functional teams and stakeholders.

title: Senior Engineer - Product Management
jobDescription:
A) Role Name :

Product Manager - Global Product Management (Compressors)


B) Role Description

  • Create a global product roadmap for Oil Free Portable air compressors, taking into consideration the end customer and distributor needs, industry trends, and competition insights.
  • Initiate and drive product development based on product strategy and new opportunities identified.
  • Provide support to the sales team by launching new products and improving existing products with Compelling Value Propositions (C-VAP) for the end customers to successfully position ELGi’s products in the market.
  • Be the global expert for products that are assigned to manage


C) Responsibilities

  1. Opportunity Management
  • Perform market study, application study, and competition benchmarking; utilize all available sources such as competition information, industry trends, and input from sales teams to identify new opportunities.
  • Analyze business potential towards revenue targets, technical feasibility, and statutory requirements to determine the value and feasibility of the opportunity and present the business case to the leadership team

2. Product Initiation & Development

  • Develop a product roadmap to initiate new products and improve existing products to get ahead of the competition, address product range gaps (if any), and ensure sustained competitiveness of the product portfolio.
  • Capture Voice of Customer (VoC), competition benchmarking and work with relevant stakeholders to develop effective product specifications.
  • Determine target product positioning and pricing.
  • Prioritize products based on business objectives.
  • Develop business case with business potential, RoI, value proposition, and business revenue targets to obtain approval for product development

3.Product Launch

  • Work closely with PDO to ensure availability of technical documents, product specifications, GA & Electrical Drawings, and O&M manual for the new product launches.
  • Prepare sales documents; catalogs, product flyers, pitch documents (ELGi vs Competition), and online sales tools to enable sales teams to win business.
  • Prepare training content and sales collaterals for newly developed products.
  • Support the marketing communications team with product value proposition and ensure it is effectively communicated and delivered to customers.
  • Work with internal stakeholders to support proper launch on time for a new product

4. Product Support

  • Support non-standard sales inquiries to provide engineering solutions to regional product managers/sales

5. Business Monitoring

  • Monitor sales trends of new products launched and conduct a comparative study with business projected during the product initiation phase to understand the gaps (if any)
  • Understand orders lost to competition on relevant products and analyze reasons to provide suitable solutions.
  • Product lifecycle management
  • Support in continuous improvement of product management systems and processes


D) Education Qualifications

  • Graduate/Postgraduate in Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering. MBA in marketing/sales preferred.


E) Core Skills

  • Mid-level; 9-10 years of experience in product management or sales of industrial products or experience in compressor product development with exposure to sales and marketing.
  • Strong market research and business acumen skills
  • Ability to analyze and provide data-driven decisions.
  • Strategic thinking
  • Strong team player. Experience of working in Global teams in preferred.

F) Experience

  • Working knowledge of compressors or any industrial machinery and their applications
  • Experience in managing product lifecycle.
  • Experience in engineering, business development and sales/data analysis on market or competition

G) Travel

  • 30-50%

H) Work Environment

  • Work with local and global stakeholders; Work with a diverse team of professionals; Collaborate with stakeholders from various functions across organization;
